items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: I told him, Bill, get somebody. Please, you've got to get somebody.

ctx.x: I'll play it up one week. One week only I'll play it. I'll be fine, listen. I'll play it. I told him, Bill, get somebody. Please, you've got to get somebody.
Which band was that then? From Bill.
